author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Join me for a chat and Q&A session with Andrea Pavlovic, the lead actress on our upcoming short film Trial By Fire, and Travis Grant, our director. 

Come see all three of our short films on opening night in Toronto: https://www.tickettailor.com/events/gradualupgradeproductions/2119044
title: Trial By Fire - A Chat With Lead Actor And Director

author: The Critical Drinker
description: The era of the mega slopbuster might be coming to an end, and the era of independent movies made by passionate creators is just beginning. Backrooms is part of a new breed of horror movies shot on low budgets, but attracting massive success. Join me for my review.
title: Backrooms Absolutely Humiliates Modern Hollywood
